summary: Nano-X Imaging Ltd. filed a routine Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's quarterly report on Form 10-Q, covering the period ended June 30, 2026. The submission contains 49 documents, chiefly financial statements, segment data for AI and software solutions, radiology services and Nanox ARC, share-based compensation, intangible asset and fair value disclosures. No special-situation event is disclosed: no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private proposal, strategic review, activist stake or capital return. No deal terms, premium, price per share or advisor are stated. What to watch: ordinary operational and cash-burn trends rather than event-driven risk arbitrage.
